title: Beyond Surface Cues: Disentangling Sociocultural Signals in Multilingual LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by prompting models with occupations in explicit sentence completion and implicit long-form narrative generation (story/news) tasks. Bias is quantified using a 'Stereotype' metric (alignment with predefined occupational gender stereotypes) and a 'Balance' metric (skew between female and male protagonist assignment probabilities).

Assessed by extracting cultural markers (e.g., toponyms, institutions, traditions) from generated narratives to compute 'self-context advantage' (relevance of the text to the source-language culture) and testing 'source-language separability' using a classification probe before and after masking surface cues like named entities and translations.
